item.title: Academic Council rejects proposed schedule changes, further discussions ensue
item.description: The Academic Council voted on Dec. 11 to reject proposed changes to the College’s academic schedule for the Fall 2026 semester, following over an hour of dialogue, amendments and concerns from various faculty across departments.
